bachelor_required.value: Bachelor's or equivalent in engineering, applied sciences or 'appropriate field', cumulative avg >= 3.0/4.3
bachelor_required.quote: Être titulaire d'un baccalauréat, ou l'équivalent, en génie, en sciences appliquées ou dans un domaine approprié, obtenu avec une moyenne cumulative d'au moins 3,0 (sur 4,3)

bachelor_field.value: Engineering, computer science, applied sciences with IT component, or appropriate field

non_cs_notes.value: Geography degree not obviously 'appropriate'; alternative route via knowledge/training/relevant professional experience in engineering environments

min_gpa.value: 3.0/4.3; 2.8-3.0 may be admitted after file review

experience_pathway.quote: candidates may possess necessary knowledge, appropriate training and relevant professional experience in engineering-focused environments

english_req.value: M.Sc.A. can be admitted on English proficiency (anglophone university diploma or English test) but must pass a 3-credit university French course to graduate AND must show a professor agreed to act as thesis director

english_waiver.value: Yes via anglophone university diploma (Nigerian English-medium degree acceptance unconfirmed)

other_requirements.value: Confirmed thesis supervisor required for English-based admission; thesis profile (30 thesis credits)

language.value: French default; English admission allowed for M.Sc.A. research profile with mandatory 3-credit French course (the M.Ing. is French-only)

deadline.value: Fall Aug 1 / Winter Dec 1 / Spring Apr 1; international earlier (dates not stated)

eligibility_notes: Provisional: English admission is possible for the M.Sc.A. but requires a pre-secured thesis director and a 3-credit French course; field requirement is engineering/CS/applied sciences or 'appropriate field', with a professional-experience alternative. Geography degree plus 5-7 yrs DevOps is case-by-case. Research/thesis format; funding, tuition and international deadlines UNKNOWN. Not ineligible.
